description: This file contains test cases for the GatewayDiscoveryModel in the OpenClawDiscovery module, validating various functionalities like gateway matching, parsing TXT records, building SSH targets, discovery continuation logic, and deduplication keys.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModelTests
classes.description: Test suite for GatewayDiscoveryModel containing multiple test cases

methods.name: `local gateway matches lan host`
methods.description: Tests if the gateway matching function correctly identifies a local gateway based on LAN host.

methods.name: `local gateway matches tailnet dns`
methods.description: Tests if the local gateway matching correctly identifies based on tailnet DNS.

methods.name: `local gateway matches display name`
methods.description: Ensures that display names correctly identify local gateways.

methods.name: `remote gateway does not match`
methods.description: Verifies that gateways not matching local identity features are correctly identified as remote.

methods.name: `local gateway matches service name`
methods.description: Tests matching based on service name.

methods.name: `service name does not false positive on substring host token`
methods.description: Ensures service name matching does not produce false positives due to substring overlaps with host tokens.

methods.name: `parses gateway TXT fields`
methods.description: Validates parsing of gateway TXT DNS records into structured data.

methods.name: `parses gateway TXT defaults`
methods.description: Checks default values when parsing incomplete TXT records.

methods.name: `builds SSH target`
methods.description: Tests SSH target string construction from user, host, and port.

methods.name: `tailscale serve discovery continues when DNS-SD already found a remote gateway`
methods.description: Verifies continuation logic for Tailscale serve discovery.

methods.name: `tailscale serve discovery stops after serve result is found`
methods.description: Ensures discovery stops when a suitable gateway is identified.

methods.name: `dedupe key prefers resolved endpoint across sources`
methods.description: Tests deduplication logic prioritizing resolved endpoints.

methods.name: `dedupe key falls back to stable ID without endpoint`
methods.description: Checks fallback to stable ID for deduplication when endpoints are missing.
